title: Guneku Holiday Workshop 2026 held at the Palace
excerpt: The second edition of the Guneku Holiday Workshop ran from 11 to 21 August 2026 at the Palace of Guneku, teaching mushroom production, edible maggots, organic fertiliser and cooking gas, and tomato paste.
sourceNote: From the workshop announcement circulated in the village group. Recorded as a completed 2026 event.
body:
The second edition of the Guneku Holiday Workshop ran from 11 to 21 August 2026 at the Palace of Guneku, convened by Vitalis Ngwa (Epenghefon).

Modules

  • Mushroom production
  • Edible maggots (ngwong) production
  • Production of organic fertiliser and cooking gas
  • Tomato paste
  • Social talks with experts from Youth and Social Affairs

The workshop was open to parents and children of reasonable age from all over Meta, with parents encouraged to involve all secondary-school-age children. The fee was 3,000 FCFA, payable at the community library.

GUDECA North America responded publicly offering support for the initiative.
